Method of Attack: DLL side-loading using older vulnerable versions of legitimate applications (Microsoft Defender, Sysinternals DebugView, McAfee on-demand scanner, Microsoft Word 2007) to load malicious DLLs
Cryptocurrency mining (Monero coin miners) as a decoy to hide real cyberespionage activity
Spear-phishing emails with customized messages and Gmail accounts to obtain initial access
Network reconnaissance and lateral movement using PowerShell cmdlets, credential theft (Mimikatz), WMI connections, and installation of Cobalt Strike beacon via DLL side-loading
Impacted Systems: Private and government organizations in France and Vietnam
Systems running Microsoft Defender, Sysinternals DebugView, McAfee on-demand scanner, Microsoft Word 2007
Attack Vector: DLL side-loading of malicious DLLs via older vulnerable legitimate applications
Credential theft and lateral movement using PowerShell and WMI
